method: group A: git merge-base --is-ancestor <head> <consolidation>. Otherwise git cherry, then for each file the PR changes, whether its head blob ever appears in the consolidation history (git log --full-history <consolidation> -- <file>): group A2 when every version appears (integrated then replaced), group B when at least one never appears.
